mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1% (p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate rise above 8.0% signals deepening recession triggering policy responses, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, the 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases (p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) signal severe labor market contraction triggering policy responses, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS fell to 131008.0 and UNRATE at 9.5% in June 2009
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, the 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases (p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In early post-recession recovery, a housing starts (HOUST) rise above 2% in the last month signals improving consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 2% in the last month
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST rose by 1.5% in May 2009 (below 2% threshold)
failure_condition: When HOUST rises > 2% in the last month, the 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases (p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 3-month moving average signals improving economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO fell to 84.7459 in June 2009 (below threshold)
failure_condition: When INDPRO rises > 1% above its 3-month MA, the 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases (p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) rise signals improving consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST rose to 540.0 and RSAFS fell to 332227.0 in June 2009
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both rise by more than 1% in the last month, the 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases (p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) rise above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation triggering monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 2.5% YoY, the 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases (p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In deep recession (GDPC1 contraction), a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving supply conditions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In deep recession (GDPC1 contraction), when INDPRO rises, the 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases (p>0.05 for positive returns).
